events.reason: The final v5 attempt passed 24 checks: full-SHA256 exact/near content rules, conservative GlobalVoices/invalid/IPv6 URL handling, language scoping, all-copy duplicate rejection, missing-ID and provenance failures, transactional rollback, close/reopen idempotence, implementation/input/provenance/confirmation bindings, incomplete-stage emission guard, atomic streamed manifest, three probe-order equivalences, and a 20,000-row generator scale probe. Peak RSS was 22,179,840 bytes. This does not qualify the 1.60 TB candidate universe or open confirmation outcomes.
